texts.Permissions:Description: Assign permissions to other users through the user management page. ABP validates and saves the grants.
texts.Permissions:StepUser: Open user management and find the user you want to authorize.
texts.Permissions:StepGrant: Choose Permissions from the user's action menu, select the required permissions, and save.
texts.Permissions:StepShop: To allow adding shops, grant both Shop Management and Creating new shops. Editing and deleting are granted separately.
texts.Permissions:ScopeHint: Role-based permissions must be changed in role management. View-all record permissions apply only to the current tenant. If menus do not update after a grant, sign in again.
